research_question: What is the effect of any iron-containing supplement, compared with the same supplement without iron or no treatment/placebo, on maternal iron-deficiency anaemia at term during pregnancy?
control_label: Supplement without iron or placebo/no treatment
outcome_description: Maternal iron-deficiency anaemia at term, defined as haemoglobin < 110 g/L plus at least one additional laboratory indicator of iron deficiency (e.g., serum ferritin, transferrin saturation) assessed at 37 weeks' gestation or later
positive_direction: A positive effect indicates a lower rate or reduction of maternal iron-deficiency anaemia at term, favoring the iron-containing supplement group
search_queries: iron supplementation pregnancy iron deficiency anaemia term trial
prenatal iron supplement maternal anaemia controlled comparison
iron pregnant women haemoglobin deficiency outcome trial
inclusion_criteria: Pregnant women receiving any oral iron-containing supplement compared to the same supplement without iron, placebo, or no treatment
Quantitative evaluation of maternal iron-deficiency anaemia at or near term (37 weeks' gestation or later)
Controlled experimental or comparative observational study designs reporting comparative outcome data
exclusion_criteria: Not an original empirical study (e.g., systematic reviews, meta-analyses, narrative reviews, editorials, commentaries, or study protocols)
No comparison between an iron-containing supplement and an identical supplement without iron or placebo/no treatment
No quantitative outcome data reported on maternal iron-deficiency anaemia or haemoglobin/iron status at term suitable for effect size calculation
Studies in non-pregnant populations or studies completely unrelated to iron supplementation in pregnancy
moderators_to_extract: Dose and frequency of iron supplementation (e.g., daily vs. intermittent, elemental iron dose)
Type of iron compound administered (e.g., ferrous sulfate, ferrous fumarate)
Co-interventions (e.g., iron alone vs. iron plus folic acid or multiple micronutrients)
Maternal baseline anaemia/iron status or setting-level anaemia prevalence
effect_size_note: Trials reporting zero events in both treatment and control arms are treated as not estimable and excluded from pooling.
